taw.definition:
n. the 23rd letter of the Hebrew alphabet
n. a large marble used for shooting in the game of marbles
taw.translation:
vt. 用明矾和盐硝(皮), 鞣制(生皮)
vi. 射石弹
n. 石弹, 弹石弹游戏, 射石弹者站立的基线

tawara's node.translation: [医] 田原氏结, 房室结

tawdrier.definition:
s. tastelessly showy
s. cheap and shoddy
tawdrier.translation: a. 俗丽的, 华而不实的( tawdry的比较级 )

tawdries.translation:
a. 非常华丽的；廉价而俗丽的
n. 俗丽的东西；廉价而俗丽之物

tawdriest.definition:
s. tastelessly showy
s. cheap and shoddy
tawdriest.translation: a. 俗丽的, 华而不实的( tawdry的最高级 )

tawdrily.definition: r in a tastelessly garish manner

tawdriness.definition: n. Quality or state of being tawdry.
tawdriness.translation: n. 俗丽, 华而不实

tawdry.definition:
s tastelessly showy
s cheap and shoddy
tawdry.translation:
a. 廉价而俗丽的
n. 廉价而俗丽之物

tawed.translation:
n. 石弹；射石弹者站立的基线
vt. 鞣制
vi. 射出石弹
abbr. 每周两次（twice a week）
n. (Taw)人名；(缅)托

tawer.definition: n. One who taws; a dresser of white leather.

tawery.definition: n. A place where skins are tawed.

tawie.translation: a. <苏格兰>顺从的,易驾驭的,易对付的

tawing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Taw

tawney.definition: n. English economist remembered for his studies of the development of capitalism (1880-1962)

tawnies.definition:
plural of tawny
s. of a light brown to brownish orange color; the color of tanned leather
tawnies.translation:
(tawny 的复数) a. 黄褐色的, 茶色的
n. 黄褐色

tawniest.translation: a. tawney（黄褐色的, 茶色的；黄褐色, 茶色）的变形

tawniness.definition: n. The quality or state of being tawny.
tawniness.translation: n. 黄褐色；茶色 (tawny的变形)

tawny.definition: s. of a light brown to brownish orange color; the color of tanned leather
tawny.translation:
a. 黄褐色的, 茶色的
n. 黄褐色

tawny owl.translation: 灰林鸮（产于欧洲的一种红褐色或灰色的鸮科猛禽）

tawny-brown.translation: [网络] 茶褐色；褐啡；黄褐色

tawpie.translation: n. <苏格兰>笨姑娘,没头脑的女人(亦作tawpy)

taws.definition:
n the 23rd letter of the Hebrew alphabet
n a large marble used for shooting in the game of marbles
taws.translation:
n. 皮鞭的一种
v. 鞭打

tawse.definition: n a leather strap for punishing children
tawse.translation:
n. 皮鞭的一种
v. 鞭打
